body_markdown:
# Google Gemma 4 now in Unsloth


[Unsloth AI](https://substack.com/@unsloth)


Apr 02, 2026


Google DeepMind releases Gemma 4 today, a new family of open models, including


**E2B** ,


**E4B** ,


**26B-A4B** , and


**31B.** These multimodal, hybrid-thinking models support 140+ languages, up to


**256K context** , and come in both dense and MoE variants. Gemma 4 can now run locally and be fine-tuned in


[Unsloth Studio](https://unsloth.ai/docs/models/gemma-4#unsloth-studio-guide) .


Thank you Google for providing Unsloth with day zero access. For more details on Gemma 4 and usage, read our blog / guide:


[Gemma 4 Blog](https://unsloth.ai/docs/models/gemma-4)


### ✨ Unsloth Updates


Since we released


[Unsloth Studio](https://unsloth.ai/docs/new/studio) 2 weeks ago, we’ve made many improvements. Most notably:


-


**50-80% more accurate Tool calling** : better parsing, better accuracy, faster execution, no raw tool markup in chat, plus a new Tool Outputs panel and timers.


-


Pre-compiled


` llama.cpp` binaries for ~1min installs and -50% less size


-


**Auto-detection of existing models** / GGUFs


-


**20–30% faster inference** , now matches


` llama-server` /


` llama.cpp` speeds.


-


New


**Desktop app shortcuts**


-


**Data Recipes** now supports


**macOS, CPU** and multi-file uploads.


[Unsloth Studio](https://unsloth.ai/docs/new/studio)


Unsloth Studio now also installs in one command:


**macOS, Linux, WSL:**


```text
curl -fsSL https://unsloth.ai/install.sh | sh
```


**Windows:**


```text
irm https://unsloth.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```


A new way to use Unsloth is also coming soon…
